ParticleEmitter.description: Component that spawns and animates short-lived visual particles. Attach to an entity, configure options, then call start() or burst().

constructorOptions.rate: number — particles emitted per second in continuous mode
constructorOptions.speed: number — initial speed in world units/second
constructorOptions.spread: number — emission cone half-angle in degrees (0 = straight line, 360 = sphere)
constructorOptions.textureName: string (optional) — asset name for sprite-sheet particles; omit for default white square

methods.start: emitter.start(): void — begin continuous emission at the configured rate
methods.stop: emitter.stop(): void — stop emitting new particles; existing particles finish their lifetime
methods.burst: emitter.burst(count: number): void — fire exactly count particles immediately, ignoring rate

properties.rate: number — read/write, effective before start() is called

notes: Call stop() in onDestroy before the entity is destroyed.
burst() does not require start() to have been called first.
Particles sharing the same textureName are batched into one draw call.
count should be kept as low as visually acceptable — all particles update every frame.

WindowSystem.description: Manages window mode, size, title, and position. Wraps Tauri native window API with transparent browser fallback. Import the singleton `windowSystem`.
WindowSystem.import: import { windowSystem, type WindowMode, type WindowConfig } from '@emptysock/engine'

apply.description: Apply all window settings at once. Call once in root scene onLoad.

setSize.description: Resize the window. No-op in fullscreen/borderless modes on desktop.

setResizable.description: Allow or prevent manual resizing. Desktop only.

setMinSize.description: Set minimum window dimensions. Desktop only.

setPosition.description: Move window to screen coordinates. Desktop only.

center.description: Centre window on the current monitor. Desktop only.

setAlwaysOnTop.description: Pin window above others. Desktop only.

UISystem.description: Canvas 2D overlay for screen-space UI (menus, HUD, dialogue boxes). Renders on top of the PixiJS scene. Access via this.uiSystem inside any Scene subclass.
UISystem.singleton: UISystem — module-level singleton, shared across all scenes

methods.add: UISystem.add(widget: Widget): void — add a root widget to the overlay
methods.removeWidget: UISystem.removeWidget(widget: Widget): void — remove a root widget
methods.clear: UISystem.clear(): void — remove all widgets and UIComponents
methods.clearWidgets: UISystem.clearWidgets(): void — remove only Widget-API roots (not legacy UIComponents)
methods.setImageLoader: UISystem.setImageLoader(loader: ImageLoader): void — override the default fetch-based loader
methods.update: UISystem.update(dt: number, pointerX?, pointerY?, cw?, ch?): void — tick animations + hover state
methods.render: UISystem.render(ctx: IUIRenderer, cw: number, ch: number): void — draw all components and widgets

methods.handlePointerMove: UISystem.handlePointerMove(x, y, cw, ch): void — update hover state

UISystem.note: UISystem constructs a default ImageLoader internally (fetch + createImageBitmap). No setup needed for the common case.

Widget.import: import { Widget, LabelWidget, ImageWidget, ButtonWidget, PanelWidget, ProgressBarWidget, SliderWidget, CheckboxWidget } from '@emptysock/engine'
Widget.description: Base class and 7 concrete widget types for building screen-space UI. Use uiSystem.add(widget) to render, uiSystem.removeWidget(widget) to remove.

baseProperties.children: Widget[] — mutable; add children with panel.children.push(child)

baseMethods.animate: widget.animate(name: AnimationName, opts?): void — names: 'fadeIn'|'fadeOut'|'slideIn'|'slideOut'|'pop'|'shake'; opts: { duration?: number, easing?: string, direction?: 'left'|'right'|'up'|'down' }

widgets.LabelWidget: new LabelWidget({ text?, font?, fontSize?, color?, align?, ...baseOpts })
widgets.ButtonWidget: new ButtonWidget({ label?, icon?, color?, background?, hoverBackground?, pressedBackground?, borderRadius?, fontSize?, font?, disabled?, animateOnHover?, ...baseOpts }) — state: "normal"|"hover"|"pressed"|"disabled"
widgets.PanelWidget: new PanelWidget({ background?, border?, borderWidth?, cornerRadius?, ...baseOpts })
widgets.ProgressBarWidget: new ProgressBarWidget({ value?, min?, max?, fillColor?, trackColor?, direction?: "h"|"v", ...baseOpts }) — .normalised: number
widgets.SliderWidget: new SliderWidget({ value?, min?, max?, step?, trackColor?, thumbColor?, onChange?, ...baseOpts }) — .normalised: number
widgets.CheckboxWidget: new CheckboxWidget({ checked?, label?, color?, background?, borderColor?, fontSize?, font?, onChange?, ...baseOpts })

VNSystem.import: import { VNSystem, type VNNode, type VNDialogueNode, type VNChoiceNode } from '@emptysock/engine'
VNSystem.description: Standalone visual novel runtime. Plays exported .vnscript files. Used by VNTextbox as its data source. For simple entity-based playback, see VNController instead.

loadScript.description: Load a .vnscript JSON file exported from the Story Graph panel.

onNode.description: Register a callback invoked whenever the active node changes. Register before calling play().

play.description: Begin playback from the start node.

advance.description: Move past the current dialogue node.

choose.description: Select a choice option by zero-based index.

jumpToNode.description: Jump to a node by id (used for save/resume).

setVariable.signature: (key: string, value: string | number | boolean): void

notes: Do not call advance() or choose() before play() — the state machine is not ready.
onNode fires once per node including after jumpToNode(). Register before play().
Condition nodes are evaluated and routed automatically — onNode is never called for them.

VNTextbox.description: Pre-built dialogue box rendered by UISystem. Bind to a VNSystem instance to auto-update.
VNTextbox.constructor: new VNTextbox({ canvasWidth, canvasHeight, height?, namePlateHeight?, paddingX?, panelColor?, namePlateColor?, textColor?, fontSize? })

VNScriptConvert.description: Converts between Story Graph (visual-editor JSON) and VNSystem DialogueTree (.vnscript JSON).

CGGallery.description: Tracks CG image unlock state, persisted via SaveSystem.
CGGallery.constructor: new CGGallery({ entries: CGEntry[], saveSystem?, saveSlot? })

BattleSystem.import: import { BattleSystem, type BattlePhase, type BattleStats, type StatusEffect, type Combatant, type SkillTargetType, type DamageFormulaId, type SkillDef, type StatusEffectDef, type BattleDatabase, type BattleAction, type BattleEvent, type BattleSystemOptions } from '@emptysock/engine'
BattleSystem.description: Opt-in turn-based RPG battle module. Handles turn order (speed desc), damage resolution, status effects, and event emission. Tree-shaken from bundles that do not import it. Enemies act automatically (attack lowest-HP party member); party members require submitAction().

BattleSystemOptions.db: BattleDatabase — optional, can also be loaded via loadDatabase()

setDamageFormula.signature: (fn: (atk: number, def: number, power: number, isCrit: boolean, critMultiplier: number) => number): void

onEvent.description: Subscribe to battle events. Returns an unsubscribe function.

start.description: Begin the battle. Fires battle-start, round-start, then action-needed for the first party member.

submitAction.description: Submit a party member's action. Only valid when getPhase() === 'input'.

types.BattleStats: { hp, maxHp, mp, maxMp, attack, defense, speed, luck: number }
types.StatusEffect: { id: string; name: string; turnsRemaining: number } — turnsRemaining -1 = permanent
types.Combatant: { id: string; name: string; stats: BattleStats; statusEffects: readonly StatusEffect[]; isParty: boolean }
types.SkillDef: { id, name, mpCost, targetType: SkillTargetType, formula: DamageFormulaId, power: number, isHeal?: boolean, statusEffect?: { effectId: string; chance: number } }
types.StatusEffectDef: { id, name, hpDrainPercentPerTurn?: number, attackMultiplier?: number, defenseMultiplier?: number }
types.BattleAction: { type: 'attack'; targetId: string } | { type: 'skill'; skillId: string; targetId: string } | { type: 'flee' }
types.BattleEvent: { kind: 'battle-start' } | { kind: 'round-start'; round: number } | { kind: 'action-needed'; combatantId: string } | { kind: 'damage'; sourceId: string; targetId: string; amount: number; isCrit: boolean } | { kind: 'heal'; sourceId: string; targetId: string; amount: number } | { kind: 'mp-cost'; combatantId: string; amount: number } | { kind: 'status-applied'; combatantId: string; effectId: string; name: string } | { kind: 'status-expired'; combatantId: string; effectId: string } | { kind: 'combatant-defeated'; combatantId: string } | { kind: 'victory' } | { kind: 'defeat' } | { kind: 'fled' }
